classes.Sourced: Facts taken from named official or voluntary-sector sources, each linked and dated.
classes.Model: A planning calculation from stated assumptions or your own inputs. It shows what would be needed, not what happened.

classes.Generated: Template or AI-written text for you to adapt. Check it before you use it.
classes.Editorial: Judgements or guidance written for this portal, based on the sources cited.
